footer.tagline: Learn. Challenge. Grow. Quizzes for curious minds.

about.title: About us
about.intro: Quizio is a focused quiz platform for creating, publishing and solving timed knowledge challenges without unnecessary clutter.

focus.title: Built around quizzes
focus.body: The product is shaped around one clear flow: an admin creates a quiz, publishes it when ready, and users solve it in a calm, readable experience.

creators.title: For creators
creators.body: Quiz creators get practical tools for questions, answers, images, points, schedules and results, so managing a quiz feels direct and predictable.

learners.title: For learners
learners.body: People solving quizzes can focus on the question, the timer and their progress, then review results and compare scores on leaderboards.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These sample terms explain the expected use of Quizio. They are placeholder content for the project and not formal legal advice.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: Users should keep their login details private and use their own account when solving quizzes or managing admin content.

content.title: Quiz content
content.body: Creators are responsible for the questions, answers, images and descriptions they publish. Content should be respectful, accurate and safe for the intended audience.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: Quizio may change features, fix issues or temporarily pause parts of the service while the platform is being improved.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains what Quizio collects, why it is collected, and how users can contact us about their data.

data.title: What we collect
data.body: We collect account email, display name, language and theme preference, quiz attempts, selected answers, scores, timestamps, uploaded quiz images and admin-created quiz content.

use.title: Why we collect it
use.body: We use this data to authenticate users, keep quiz progress, calculate results, show dashboards and leaderboards, support admin review, and keep the service reliable.

control.title: Contact
control.body: For privacy questions or data requests, contact us at guiziomaster@gmail.com.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: We keep account and quiz records while the account or project is active. Finished attempts and leaderboard records are kept as long as they are needed for quiz history, review and scoring, unless deletion is requested and legally allowed.

sharing.title: No third-party sale
sharing.body: We do not sell personal data and do not share it with third-party actors for advertising. Data is only processed to provide Quizio features and infrastructure.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of your data, and you may object to certain processing where applicable.

cookies.label: Cookie notice
cookies.title: Cookie notice
cookies.body: Quizio uses necessary cookies for sign-in sessions and security. We do not use marketing cookies.

home.heroSubtitle: Build timed quizzes, publish them to users, collect answers and show results in a clean quiz experience.
home.whySubtitle: Quizio is designed around one simple flow: create a quiz, publish it, solve it and understand the result.

features.createDesc: Build questions, answers, points and time limits.
features.publishDesc: Open quizzes at the right time and let users solve them.
features.trackDesc: Show scores, attempts and public leaderboards.

testimonials.t1quote: Creating a quiz feels fast and clear. The admin flow focuses on the important things: questions, answers, time and results.
testimonials.t2quote: The solving experience is simple. I can see the question, choose an answer and continue without distractions.
testimonials.t3quote: The platform has a clean structure and can grow into a real quiz module for larger applications.
